description: A wallet's SOL balance and its balances in higher.fun coins, each valued at the coin's last price. Coins are recognised on-chain (a LaunchLab pool on higher.fun's platform), so look-alike tokens don't show up. Pass mints to check only those coins, which is faster and works for wallets holding thousands of tokens.

mints.description: Only these coins, at most 50. Omit to list every higher.fun coin the wallet holds.

items.description: The coin's mint address (base58). higher.fun mints usually end in 'high'.

name: get_wallet_positions
title: Get wallet positions
